name: Furnace Ignitor Replacement
description: The hot-surface ignitor lights the burners. It's a common wear item, typically failing every 3–7 years.

name: Flame Sensor Cleaning or Replacement
description: The flame sensor confirms burners are lit. A dirty sensor is one of the most common causes of short cycling.
signals: Furnace lights then shuts off quickly

name: Limit Switch Replacement
description: The high-limit switch shuts the furnace down when it overheats. Replacement restores safe operation after airflow issues are fixed.
signals: Furnace shuts off before reaching temperature

name: Pressure Switch Replacement
description: The pressure switch verifies the inducer is moving combustion gases safely before ignition is allowed.
signals: Furnace tries to start but stops before ignition

name: Inducer Motor Replacement
description: The inducer motor pulls combustion gases through the heat exchanger and out the vent. A failed motor prevents safe operation.

name: Gas Valve Replacement
description: The gas valve controls fuel flow to the burners. Failures require licensed service due to combustion safety requirements.
signals: Burners fail to ignite with good ignitor

name: Blower Motor Replacement
description: The blower motor moves heated air through your ductwork. ECM motors cost more but run more efficiently.

name: Control Board Replacement
description: The control board manages ignition sequence, safety checks, and blower operation. Board failures cause varied error codes.

name: Thermostat Replacement
description: The thermostat sends the heat call to the furnace. A faulty or incompatible stat can mimic furnace failures.

name: Thermocouple Replacement
description: Standing-pilot furnaces use a thermocouple to prove the pilot flame. A weak thermocouple shuts off gas to the pilot.
signals: No heat on older pilot furnaces

name: Capacitor Replacement
description: Run capacitors help blower and inducer motors start. A failed capacitor causes hum-without-spin symptoms.

name: Heat Exchanger Replacement
description: The heat exchanger separates combustion gases from indoor air. Cracks or rust can trigger rollout or CO risks.

name: Condensate Pump Replacement
description: High-efficiency furnaces produce condensate that must drain. A failed pump or clogged line triggers safety lockouts.

name: Furnace Filter Replacement
description: A clean filter protects airflow and prevents overheating. Most limit and rollout issues start with a clogged filter.

name: Full Furnace Replacement (80% AFUE)
description: Replacing an standard-efficiency gas furnace includes the unit, basic venting, permit, and haul-away.

name: Full Furnace Replacement (96% AFUE)
description: High-efficiency condensing furnaces cost more but save fuel. Installation includes PVC venting and condensate drainage.

name: AC Condenser Replacement
description: The outdoor condenser rejects heat from your home. Replacement includes the unit, refrigerant charge, and startup.
signals: Warm air from vents in cool mode

name: Full HVAC System Replacement
description: A full system replacement includes a new furnace and air conditioner or heat pump, matched for efficiency and capacity.
